## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — REQ-6, REQ-8, AC-7, AC-8 + decomposition PR 7.

## Surface
- `docs/operations/ozone-migration.md` — operator runbook
- Sections (in order):
  1. Prerequisites (Polaris running, fresh DB, key in hand)
  2. Signing key parity — read `OZONE_SIGNING_KEY_HEX`, configure Polaris `[labeler.signing_key] mode = "file-plain"`, verify with `polaris labeler-key show` that public key matches Ozone's declared key
  3. Snapshot Ozone (pg_dump)
  4. Run `polaris-ozone-import import --source <dump> --target <polaris-db>`
  5. Run `polaris-ozone-import verify` — confirm zero discrepancies
  6. Shadow-mode period: both Ozone and Polaris subscribing to firehose; per-subject report counts converge within 1 minute (AC-8)
  7. Cutover: stop Ozone's `subscribeLabels`; Polaris's `app.bsky.labeler.service` already declares the same signing key, so downstream consumers continue without noticing the swap
  8. Decommission Ozone, retain dump for rollback window
  9. Rollback procedure — stop Polaris, redeploy Ozone from snapshot, repoint downstream traffic
  10. Troubleshooting (mapping errors, key mismatch, schema-version refusal)

## Rust-quality notes
- Per rust-quality §8: every CLI invocation in the runbook is copy-pasteable. No `<placeholder>` text without a documented value.
- Each section has a "verify" subsection — how the operator confirms the step succeeded before proceeding.
- The runbook is the deliverable for AC-7 (key parity instructions) and AC-8 (shadow-mode procedure).
- CI markdown-lint passes on the new file.

## External references
- v1 ops runbook (reference style): `docs/ops/runbook.md`
- v1 labeler-key admin commands: existing `polaris labeler-key` subcommands

## Acceptance (AC-7, AC-8)
- [ ] `docs/operations/ozone-migration.md` exists, ≥300 lines, covers all 10 sections.
- [ ] AC-7: An operator following the runbook ends up with Polaris emitting labels verifiable against the same Ozone-declared signing key. End-to-end verification on a staging deployment.
- [ ] AC-8: Shadow-mode test (both running) — per-subject report counts converge within 1 minute on the test fixture.
